verdict.rationale: Supabase's own first-party docs say you can self-host Supabase on your own computer, server, or cloud infrastructure, and that self-hosted Supabase does not phone home. That lets a user decide where auth data lives. However, the pack shows no hosted-cloud region selection or formal data-residency guarantees, so choice is evidenced only through self-hosting. Missing for 10: a hosted region picker or residency controls, documented residency/compliance commitments, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Install and run your own Supabase on your computer, server, or cloud infrastructure.
Self-hosted Supabase **does not phone home or collect any telemetry**.
